blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Department of Education (DepEd) is preparing to launch a School Digital Safety CDampaign for students, teachers, and parents, following recent school shootings, which underscored the need for an approach to safety that goes beyond what happens inside the campus. As authorities continue to investigate the incidents, including reported online activity in connection with the Banga National High School case, DepEd has started moving to strengthen awareness and prevention in the digital spaces where children increasingly learn and interact. As a statement issued on Monday points out, DepEd has already been strengthening school safety by implementing measures such as […]...
